column1: # Hand labels for the stop guard's own decisions: every block line, every
# allow whose reason is handback-text, handback-line or cap, and every
# log-failed allow whose displaced reason is one of those three or a refusal
# (open-tasks, live-shell), keyed by the decision ts. Labelled from the
# archived transcript, before tally.py is run for the decision; an unlabelled
# decision makes the tally refuse to decide.
